variants.label: Text Field
variants.tooltip: Used for input of a single line of text.

placeholder.description: Text displayed when text is empty

enabled.description: If user should be allowed to alter text.

deferUpdates.description: When true, updates to props.text will be deferred until focus is lost or enter is pressed.

rejectUpdatesWhileFocused.description: When true, props.text will not accept updates from external sources while focused.

spellcheck.description: When true, the component will highlight potential spelling errors while text is being edited.
